entries.source: Each map opens with recommended settings and keeps your choices as you switch sheets.

drafts.zu: Imephu ngayinye ivuleka ngezilungiselelo ezinconyiwe futhi igcina ukukhetha kwakho lapho ushintsha amashidi.
drafts.st: Mmapa ka mong o bula ka di-setting tse kgothaletswang mme o boloka dikgetho tsa hao ha o fetola maqephe.
drafts.ts: Mepe wun’wana ni wun’wana wu pfuleka hi swiyimiso leswi bumabumeriwaka naswona wu hlayisa leswi u swi hlawuleke loko u cinca maphepha.
drafts.ve: Mapa muṅwe na muṅwe u vulea nga nzudzanyo dzi themendelwaho nahone u vhulunga zwe na nanga musi ni tshi shandula masiaṱari.

drafts.st: Hlahloba di-setting tsa mmapa ka mong
drafts.ts: Kambela swiyimiso swa mepe wun’wana ni wun’wana
drafts.ve: Ṱolani nzudzanyo dza mapa muṅwe na muṅwe

entries.source: Open Glossy and choose a sheet. Adjust its style, background or labels; your choices stay selected when you switch maps and return.

drafts.zu: Vula i-Glossy ukhethe ishidi. Lungisa isitayela, ingemuva noma amalebula; ukukhetha kwakho kuhlala kukhethiwe lapho ushintsha amamephu bese ubuya.
drafts.st: Bula Glossy mme o kgethe leqephe. Fetola setaele, bokamorao kapa dileibole; dikgetho tsa hao di sala di kgethilwe ha o fetola dimmapa mme o kgutla.
drafts.ts: Pfula Glossy u hlawula phepha. Cinca xitayele, le ndzhaku kumbe malebulu; leswi u swi hlawuleke swi sala swi hlawuriwile loko u cinca mimepe u tlhela u vuya.
drafts.ve: Vulani Glossy ni nange siaṱari. Shandulani tshitaila, murahu kana madzina; zwe na nanga zwi dzula zwo nangwa musi ni tshi shandula mapa na u vhuya.
